complete_examples.text: The primary suspension system is actionable between the bogie frame and the wheelset, which adopts the linear spring-dashpot element characterized by longitudinal, lateral, and vertical stiffness coefficients, kpx, kpy, and kpz, and the vertical damping coefficient cpz, while the secondary suspension system plays a role in shock absorption between the car body and the bogie frame, where the spring-dashpot element is also adopted with longitudinal, lateral and vertical stiffness and damping coefficients, namely ksx, ksy, ksz, and csx, csy, csz.
